records.question: can you write me an essay about ivers portfolio

result.answer:
Iver Macaulay is an AI engineer who builds practical automation, call intelligence, lead-scoring, data-extraction, and operational systems. His portfolio shows a focus on turning business information into useful decisions and next steps.

Mac Digital is a responsive website for services and practical AI integrations. Its interactive demo turns a business prompt into a browsable website concept with generated copy, optional imagery, and selectable layouts and typography.

Drop It is a private saved-for-later library for screenshots, files, text, and links, with a React interface and a ChatGPT-compatible MCP server. Users can review AI-drafted summaries and transcription, then retrieve saved content through keyword or optional hybrid search.

Amountly is an accounting workspace for bills, expenses, invoices, and tax preparation, organized around the next financial action. It includes financial search and task-oriented money workflows.

One example of Iver’s automation work is the AI Call Intelligence Pipeline. It transcribes RingCentral recordings, analyzes calls to classify lead quality, customer type, and service location, and sends scored lead details, recordings, and transcript notes to HubSpot. It also includes safeguards for duplicate and internal calls, non-leads, and invalid location values.

Together, these projects illustrate a portfolio spanning interactive AI experiences, personal information management, accounting workflows, and business call automation. Iver describes his approach as making AI direct, dependable, and part of the workflows people already use.
